interrogation.Q06_economic_value_measurement: Reduction in unauthorized execution attempts under stale context; reduction in diagnostic latency for context-drift failure modes.
interrogation.Q09_value_multiplying_delta: Runtime orientation telemetry hook integration and live policy boundary design.
